{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial Security Authorization''' was a document issued by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] to those who passed a background check. With the document, they have access to certain levels of secure [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installations.
